column3: Well then, I can make my first spectacular debut as her assistant.
Please enter. Although it's a little urgent, I've something to ask of you.
Ah, sorry. It seems that I've done something weird here...
If you've made a mistake, just press Ctrl and Z together to undo it.
It's easy to fail at the beginning, so as a precaution, please don't accidentally overwrite and delete the original file.
Ah... This can't be used anymore.
I've backed up every file on this side.
You have to start from scratch from here if you make another mistake... That's your punishment for the mistake.
I'm really... sorry. I'm just giving you trouble here.
Don't worry about it. I've said it before, haven't I? Your mistake is within my calculations. I don't have much expectations from you since the beginning.
...Wait, why is her face so red?
Hey, are you all right? Are you running a fever...
It's pretty uncomfortable for the both of us to work in silence...
